claims.claim: The DP Compact Portable Rechargeable LED Torch Light is suitable for homes, security personnel,...
claims.evidence: The witness photos show a black solar module labeled “LUMETT SOLAR ENERGY NIG.” No torch/light is shown, and no DP Compact torch details appear.

risks.risk: The item may not be a torch/light at all; it appears to be a solar panel/module, so the listing could be mismatched or misleading.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the actual product label/packaging showing “DP Compact Portable Rechargeable LED Torch Light” (or a photo of the torch itself).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a solar module only (worst-case: unknown wattage/condition), with no functional guarantee.

risks.risk: Wattage/rating is unknown; without visible electrical specifications, output could be far below expectations.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the module’s rating label showing watts (W), voltage (V), and current (A).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest plausible performance tier for an unverified/unknown-rated module.

risks.risk: Condition is uncertain beyond partial close-ups (possible cracks, delamination, water ingress, or damaged junctions).
risks.proof: Full front and back photos plus a close-up of the junction/port area and any visible damage under good light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as damaged/untested condition (worst-case) until a full inspection photo set is provided.

risks.risk: Foldable vs rigid and size are unknown; capacity and usability depend on dimensions and number of panels.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full unfolded/complete module with dimensions (or a tape-measure shot) and whether it is foldable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the smallest/least capable configuration consistent with the visible module type.

risks.risk: No working test results are shown; solar modules may be non-functional or degraded.
risks.proof: A short video test under direct sunlight showing measured output (multimeter/solar tester reading) and/or charging a known battery with a controller (if included).
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-working/untested until output is demonstrated.

risks.risk: Brand/model/serial/warranty are not provided; authenticity and support are uncertain.
risks.proof: A photo of the serial number/label and any warranty/receipt document.
risks.if_unproven: Price without warranty/support (worst-case) until documentation is shown.

proof_requests: Confirm the exact item: provide photos of the torch/light if that is what is being sold, or confirm it is a solar module and update the listing accordingly.
Send a clear close-up of the solar module rating label (watts, voltage, current).
Send full front and back photos, including the junction/port area and any connectors/cables.
Show whether it is foldable or rigid and provide full dimensions (tape-measure photo).
Provide a working test: measured output under sun (solar tester/multimeter) and/or charging a battery (video).
Provide serial number and any warranty/receipt proof.
response.reason: The witness photos identify a solar module labeled “LUMETT SOLAR ENERGY NIG.”, while the seller’s words describe a torch/light; key pricing drivers (wattage, condition, and working test) are not visible. Without those proof shots, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
